name: Waikato River Authority contestable funding round
summary: Annual contestable round allocating around NZD 6 million to restoration and protection projects in the Waikato and Waipā river catchments. Applicants must consult river iwi and show co-funding.

eligibility.rule: Demonstrates financial viability, has a bank account in the entity name and can issue invoices
Is GST registered when yearly project costs are $60,000 or more
Is not registered as bankrupt or insolvent
Project is not a commercial activity or for private gain
Project is not required by legislation, consent conditions or regulatory compliance
Does not owe reports or money to the Waikato River Authority

documents: Proof of iwi consultation or iwi support
Authority letter or email for marae, iwi or hapū organisation
GST number evidence, if GST registered
Bank account screenshot or deposit slip

eligibility.quote: your organisation is able to demonstrate financial viability and has a bank account in the entity name, and is able to issue invoices

Applicants that are registered as bankrupt or insolvent.
Commercial activities, including but not limited to: new developments, tourism ventures, required work for a commercial organisation, and profit-generating activities for private gain.

after_award.quote: Project reports and invoices with supporting documentation to be submitted at least every 6 months.
